subject: Wilderness copied-client load timing after S6 Alia Das transfer
setup: Isolated copied 1.16.5.0 client, Wine prefix, Auth/Game server and databases from the checkpoint used by bootcamp-s6-rogers-ordinary-route-20260924.json. This run increased only the harness HUD wait ceiling from 120 to 300 seconds and requested a 240-second probe; no live Docker/DIT use or game source change.

observations.finding: The client authenticated at 01:32:31.452 local, connected to Game at 01:32:32.380, and requested character switch at 01:32:35.318. Thus it did open the game-server connection before the Wilderness loading screen.

observations.uncertainty: Timestamps are the copied server log clock, with millisecond print precision; client event may precede log receipt by network scheduling.
observations.finding: MapLoaded arrived at 01:36:26.688, 231.370 seconds after RequestSwitchToCharacterInSlot. No Game Error/Failed log line was present in this run.

At the 240-second HUD probe limit the image still showed the Wilderness Entering Battle screen and the fixed HUD pixel was white. The harness stopped the client afterward. It did not observe a playable HUD.

assessment: The prior 60/110-second HUD timeouts occurred while the client was still loading or near its MapLoaded event. This longer copied run establishes a variable 231-second switch-to-MapLoaded delay and still does not establish whether the HUD would appear shortly afterward. Game authentication and character switching worked. No concrete server fault was identified; a server implementation change is unsupported by this evidence. The remaining test boundary is a copied-client run that continues for at least 30 seconds after MapLoaded, ideally with packet/send tracing and client CPU profiling if the HUD remains absent.
